act: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (as applicable to Delhi), Schedule I-A

source.ref: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Sch. I-A Art. 33 (Delhi)
source.quoted_text: Sch I-A Art. 33 (both columns): 'GIFT - Instrument of, not being a settlement (No.58), or will or transfer (No. 62)' — 'The same duty as Conveyance (No.23) on the value of property.' So the STAMP component = Art 23 rate (3%, 2% women) on property value; transfer duty (gift is in the DMC s.147 list) rides as a separate modifier. Reconciles with the official Dept. of Revenue combined framing: 'Stamp & Transfer Duty @ 4% if the donee is a woman and @ 6% if the donee is a man'; property must be valued by an approved valuer.

pending_verification.reason: The primary 10-Jul-2023 MCD notification has not yet established that the transfer-duty hike applies to gifts, and joint-donee and family-concession treatment remain unresolved. Refuse gift totals until that municipal scope is proved.

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH (official combined totals + Sch I-A structure). Now encoded exactly as the statute reads: a CROSS-REF to Conveyance (No.23) re-based on property value — the engine imports only the Art 23 charge (3/2 by transferee_category of the DONEE), then this rule's own transfer-duty modifiers apply. Donee gender uses the same transferee_category fact (female → 2% stamp + 2%/3% transfer). Joint-donee treatment NOT stated on the official page — 'joint' resolves via the Art 23 RateSpec (2.5 PENDING) but no golden asserts it; confirm. Family-relation concessions for gifts: none encoded — Delhi has no general relative concession in the sources reached; confirm (PRD §5.5 requires the per-state relative list be explicit).
